page.title: Invoices & bills
page.subtitle: What clients owe you, and what you owe vendors

form.addPartyFirst: Add one in Clients & vendors first

list.showLinked: {count, plural, one {Show # linked entry} other {Show # linked entries}}
list.hideLinked: {count, plural, one {Hide # linked entry} other {Hide # linked entries}}

confirm.void: Void this in the app? The e-invoice is not cancelled with the tax office.
confirm.unlink: Unlink this entry? It stays in the ledger.

toast.linked: {kind, select, FEE {Fee} other {Payment}} linked to {direction, select, PAYABLE {bill} other {invoice}}

edit.paidNote: Recorded payments don't change; paid status is rechecked against the new total.

payment.title: Record payment — {label}
payment.shortfallNote: Enter what you actually paid. Any shortfall shows as still to pay.
payment.feePlaceholder: What the bank kept, if any
payment.feeNote: If the bank withheld a fee, enter it too.
payment.feeDesc: Bank fee deducted from a receipt
payment.noFeeCategories: No expense categories — add one in Settings

link.title: Link a ledger entry — {label}
link.paymentHelp: For a payment already in the ledger, or one transfer that covers several invoices.
link.feeHelp: Choose a fee entry with evidence attached (bank advice or receipt).
link.noChoices: No {type, select, INCOME {income} other {expense}} entries in {currency} left to allocate

errors.datesRequired: Enter the issue and due dates.
errors.dueBeforeIssue: Due date ({due}) is before the issue date ({issue}) — pick {issue} or later.
errors.clientRequired: Choose a client. Not listed? Add it in Clients & vendors.
errors.vendorRequired: Choose a vendor. Not listed? Add it in Clients & vendors.
errors.partyGone: That {direction, select, PAYABLE {vendor} other {client}} no longer exists — choose another one from the list.
errors.invoiceNumberRequired: Enter the invoice number, or tick “No invoice yet”.
errors.billNumberRequired: Enter the bill number, or tick “No invoice yet”.
errors.currencyLocked: Unlink the payments first to change the currency.
errors.moreThanOpen: That's more than what's still open ({amount}).
errors.usdAccount: {account} is a USD account — this invoice is in {currency}.
errors.entryReversed: That entry has been reversed — link its correction instead.
errors.currencyMismatch: That entry is in {entryCurrency}; this invoice is in {currency}.
errors.receivableNeedsIncome: A receivable is settled by income.
errors.billNeedsExpense: A bill is settled by an expense.
errors.feeMustBeExpense: A fee must be an expense entry.
errors.feeNeedsEvidence: Attach the fee evidence (bank advice or receipt) to that entry first.
errors.notEnoughFree: That entry only has {amount} left to allocate.
errors.postedUnlink: That payment is posted — only the owner can unlink it.
errors.ownerOnlyVoid: Only the owner can void an invoice.
errors.hasPayments: It has payments linked — unlink them first.
errors.feeInvalid: Enter the fee as an amount of 0 or more.
errors.feeReceiptsOnly: A deducted fee can only be entered for money received.
errors.feeTooLarge: The fee must be less than the amount settled.
errors.feeCategory: Choose the expense category for the fee.
errors.withheldFee: This bank fee was withheld from a receipt and is already counted there.
errors.entryRejected: This entry was rejected — fix and resubmit it, then link.
errors.postedLink: That entry is posted — only the owner can link it.
errors.belowSettled: {amount} is already settled — enter {amount} or more.

form.noInvoiceYet: No invoice number yet. Add it when the invoice arrives.

payment.intro: Creates a new ledger entry. Already in the ledger? Use Link ledger entry instead.
payment.feeNote: The invoice gets the full amount, fee included, and the fee becomes an expense. Without a fee, any shortfall stays open.

link.feeHelp: A difference without evidence is never treated as a fee.
